buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic The buyer organization is an institution eligible for concessional rates of GST as notified by the Government of India. The goods for which bids have been invited fall under classification of GST concession and the conditions for eligibility of concession are met by the institution. A certificate to this effect will be issued by Buyer to the Seller after award of the Contract. Sellers are requested to submit their bids after accounting for the Concessional rate of GST. Applicable Concessional rate of GST : 5 % Notification No.and date : dated 17/09/2025 3. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 4. Sample Clause

After award of contract – Successful Bidder shall have to get advance sample approved from buyer before bulk manufacturing / starting bulk supplies. Successful Bidder shall submit 50 samples for Buyer's approval, within 21 days of award of contract. Buyer shall, as per contract specifications framework, either approve the advance sample or will provide complete list of modification required in the sample within 21 days of receipt of advance sample. Seller shall be required to ensure supply as per approved sample with modifications as communicated by Buyer. If there is delay from buyer side in approval of advance sample – the delivery period shall be refixed without LD for the period of delay in sample approval. In case, the sample is found to have major deviations / not conforming to the Contract specifications, the buyer at its discretion may call for fresh samples for approval before allowing bulk supplies or may terminate the contract after notifying the deviations to the seller. Unless otherwise provided in the contract, all samples required for test shall be supplied by the contractor free of cost. Where under the contract, the contractor is required to submit an advance sample, any expenses incurred by the contractor on or in connection with the production of stores in bulk, before the sample has been approved unconditionally shall be borne by the Seller and he shall not claim any compensation in the event of such sample being found unacceptable by the Buyer / Consignee. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Terms & Conditions 01. Ceramic base shall confirm to the following technical specifications - Material: 96% Alumina (min.) Density: 3.85 ± 0.1 g/cc Hardness: 1600 Vickers Compressive strength: 2,500 ksc 2 o Thermal conductivity: 0.05 cal/cm /cm.sec/ C 02. Heat treatment of ceramic base shall be done as per the procedure followed in the expt. No HIC/VSSC/ 01 Dt 10.6.95 on ceramic bases supplied against P.O. no. SB/1007/93/8283 Dt 13/12/94. 03. Thoroughness of the holes should be ensured before supply. 04. All the dimensions mentioned in the drawings are to be strictly adhered to and inspection report is also to be sent along with the samples. 05. Initial cracking load of the bases should be more than 250 kg when load is applied in longitudinal direct ion. Load testing details are to be furnished with & without plunger (drawing of plunger to be supplied by us). 06. Party has to realize a new mould and qualify the same before production. One mould should not be use d for production of more than 20000 units of ceramic base. 07. Party has to supply samples (50 nos.) with material test certificate for evaluation at our end and appro val on receipt of the Contract. Samples should also have undergone heat treatment before supply. 08. Along with samples, party has to supply the following test specimens for evaluating of mechanical / the rmal / electrical properties at our end. -0.1 ɸ 15.0 X 1.5 mm (5 nos.) -0.1 ɸ 12.7 X 1.5 mm (5 nos.) ɸ 10 X 10 mm (5 nos.) ɸ 5 X 5 mm (5 nos.) No payment will be made for the test specimens. 09. Samples along with test specimen shall be supplied within 2 months of order placement. 10. Bulk production and supply may be commenced only after approval from our end. Bulk supply shall be made within 4 months of approval of samples. Moulds realized for production of ceramic base shall be sup plied to VSSC along with bulk supply.

11. The item shall be packed properly and transported safely and the party has to ensure that the item rea ched at our end without any damage. You shall quote as per the technical specification mentioned in ATC Document. Your bid will be evaluat ed based on our required specification attached in ATC document. Bidder should mandatorily submit A TC compliance statement along with the Bid. Bids without ATC compliance statement will be summarily rejected. For all bid clarification queries related to this bid. No.A650 2026 00 3595 in all correspondence.
